spellRows.o: 锁定技，回合结束时，你受到1点伤害并执行一个额外的出牌阶段。
当一名角色于其回合内首次受到伤害后，你可以摸一张牌并选择一项：1.令其回复1点体力；2.令其此回合下次造成的伤害+1。然后当其此回合造成伤害时，其此回合手牌上限改为0。

sameProductExplanation.title: 4399三国杀OL 虎贲系列武将：张翼攻略！
sameProductExplanation.role: Same-product explanatory evidence, subordinate to today's official page/client wording.
supportedDetails: Dianjun's one damage is genuine damage: at one HP it first opens dying/rescue; Kangrui resolves only after surviving that dying sequence.
The inserted flow is one additional Play phase, without Preparation, Discard or Ending. The guide explicitly illustrates retaining three cards after an end-of-turn recovery at two HP.
Kangrui's damage option affects the next damage instance, not every damage instance of the next card. The guide's Savage Assault example increases only the first damaged target.
Dianjun can still provide Play after the normal Play was skipped by Indulgence.

primarySemantics: Dianjun is mandatory at the owner's actual turn end. It requests one source-less native damage, then inserts a single Play phase after all resulting damage, rescue and after-damage children return.
Kangrui triggers only after the first positive actual damage received by the actual turn owner in that same turn. HP loss and prevented attempts do not count; source-less actual damage does count.
The drawer and decision maker is the Kangrui owner; the recovery/next-damage recipient is the frozen injured turn owner.
Both choices are followed by the same issued conditional effect: after that recipient actually deals damage in the issued turn, their hand limit is set to zero for that turn.
The bonus expires with the actual turn, consumes once per recipient's next damage instance, and is independent of whether that damage came from a card or a pure skill.
implementationInferences: Dianjun supplies no source in its text, so its damage uses the native source-less path rather than inventing Zhang Yi as damage source.

The current official/client '然后' clause is outside both numbered options; hand-limit arming therefore follows either option. The 2023 guide emphasizes option two's practical danger but does not override the current full text.
An issued Kangrui resolution freezes recipient and actual turn before its real owner draw. Later source skill loss does not undo that paid draw or retarget its recovery/conditional effects.
Conditional hand-limit setting requires actual positive sourced damage; a prevented attempt cannot set the hand limit to zero.

No client server implementation or authoritative FAQ about prevention consuming an already applied next-damage increment was exposed by these sources; the increment follows the engine's native damage-amount modification timing.

A Kangrui increment armed between actual chained recipients affects only the next damage instance. Its recipient-local increment is removed before another propagation step, while an increment already included in the original elemental damage remains in the inherited chain base. Both the formal-armor recalculation path and the legacy finalized propagation path retain the native attack owner and use scalar instance provenance.
runtimeBoundaries: Pending selection, draw/recovery receipt and end damage/extra-Play return remain on the owning ProgramSkillFrame and typed end parent.
Durable first-damage, issued effect, consumed increment and zero-hand-limit facts are scalar events, without an out-of-frame mutable pending ledger.
Native movement, HP/recovery, replacement, damage, rescue and source-loss child returns must complete exactly once across checkpoints.

The inserted phase's return performs native actual-turn cleanup once under the original end program, including newly used Alcohol and native held-card returns. A cleanup movement child finishes before the frozen original end parent advances; no second TurnEnded/Ending/Discard is emitted.
